name: AFM level 1 task 10: Spatially Resolved Roughness And Friction
description: Treat the initial scan center as ($\pu{0 µm}$, $\pu{0 µm}$). Acquire one contact-mode lateral-force image centered at the origin using a scan size of $\pu{2 µm} \times \pu{2 µm}$, resolution of $256 \times 256$ pixels, time per line of 0.075 s, setpoint of 0.1 V, and P/I/D gains of 100/50/0. From this single acquisition, calculate rms and mean roughness from the height channel and average friction magnitude. Report all roughness values in nanometres ($\pu{nm}$). Report all friction-signal values, in volts ($\pu{V}$) from the lateral channel.
submission_format: {"rms_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "average_friction_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_1": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>"} e.g. {"rms_roughness_1": "42.78", "mean_roughness_1": "34.20", "average_friction_1": "0.12", "path_1": "/results/afm_images/image1.nid"} Return one JSON object. Example values are illustrative, not target answers. Enter numerical values without unit text, using the units specified in the question.
